name: 2.9.16 - Buffalo details (Tempe's rules)
notes: Buffalo details by Tempe's rules: Copy Buffalo Details on the Invoice tab now fills only Receiver Information and Consignment Items. Receiver: everything from Ship to (name; the first address line, Address 2 left blank; suburb; email; contact; phone = Mobile Ph, else Bus Ph, else Home Ph; reference = the invoice's own Repair Order number). Items: one row per type, reference = the Repair Order number: PAS (a tyre 215 mm wide or less, 8 kg), SUV (over 215, 15 kg), TRUCK (a 17.5, 19.5 or 22.5 rim, 40 kg), CARTON (each wheel, or one per small-box line such as wheel nuts, 20 kg); Total Weight = Qty x kg. A line is counted only when its words clearly name one tyre, wheel or small box; packages, sets, credits, back orders, tubes, rings, possibly fitted wheel and tyre packages and anything unclear are UNRESOLVED, and the text then ends NOT READY FOR BOOKING. With nothing unresolved it ends ALL FILLED IN BY TEMPE'S BUFFALO RULES: still check the rows against the invoice, then enter them in Buffalo yourself. Nothing is sold, saved, booked or sent; Sold stays disabled. Not yet checked on a live COSTAR. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
